items.text: AC1 Notification channels: log driver logged; real drivers vs fakes (provider ids, 4xx/5xx bounded retries); opt-out after queueing; missing template var; quiet hours defer; network guard
AC2 Member messaging: coach + front-desk threads; minor rule; internal notes never member-facing; attachments signed URLs + authz; admin Inbox
AC3 Community: report->queue->remove hidden + author notified; block both ways incl. groups; rate limit 429; approval mode; admin Community module
AC4 Tasks: idempotent generation across runs; branch scope 404; outcome on complete; status-strip count; Create task from alerts/member/lead
AC5 Coach view: trainer sees only assigned; safety check-in -> coach flag, no analytics event; opted-out excluded
AC6 Broadcasts: preview = actual recipients; threshold approval; dry run no deliveries; cost = recipients x rate
AC7 Quick add member: duplicate detection with link; created member can be activated
AC8 Command palette: e2e keyboard flow to member detail; Record payment opens payment flow; axe clean
AC9 New screens: loading/empty/error/permission/offline component tests; e2e per module; standard gates + pnpm e2e
navFor permission-aware for new modules; reception <= 7 (test)
Automations and dunning use the NotificationService; Automations UI shows real channel availability
